_notes: How each kind of ground plays. Numbers are multipliers on top of the club's own values, so fairway = 1 everywhere. roll = how fast rolling slows the ball (bigger = stops sooner). bounce = how much speed a bounce keeps (smaller = the ball dies). lie_power / lie_sweet_spot = next shot from here: fraction of max power, and of the club's sweet-spot window (a club's 'recovery' cancels part of this). penalty = 'water' (drop near where it went in, +1) or 'oob' (replay from the previous spot, +1). color = how it's drawn. To add a surface, add an entry here and use it in a hole file.
